report.clinical_summary: The patient has been diagnosed with HIV (chronic stage) and has been taking Triumeq daily for about 3 years. They report intermittent adherence - taking breaks from medication when feeling well, which leads to worsening symptoms (headaches, fatigue). They experience persistent headaches as side effects that affect work focus and parenting presence. They feel guilty about prioritizing their health and worry about long-term implications. They want support from others living with HIV and strategies to manage stress and find a medication regimen with fewer side effects.
